keys.title: Ingestion keys
keys.intro: SDKs send events with an ingestion key. Keys are listed by ID only; the full key is shown once, when it is created or rotated.
keys.noPermission: You need the keys.manage permission to see and manage this project's ingestion keys.
keys.emptyBody: Create a key to start sending events to this project.

createDialog.title: Create an ingestion key
createDialog.body: Name the key after where it is used, so you know which one to rotate or revoke later.
createDialog.name: Name

rotateDialog.title: Rotate key {keyId}?
rotateDialog.body: A new key replaces this one. The old key keeps working for the rotation grace period so you can roll out the new one, then stops.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke key {keyId}?
revokeDialog.body: Requests with this key are refused immediately. This cannot be undone.

secret.title: Copy your new ingestion key
secret.intro: Configure your SDK with this key.
secret.oldKeyExpires: The old key {keyId} keeps working until {time}.
secret.warning: This key will not be shown again. Copy it and store it in your secret manager now.
secret.label: Ingestion key {keyId}
secret.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the key and copy it yourself.
